verdict.rationale: 1Password documents storing one-time passwords and offers export, CSV import, and Credential Exchange import on iOS 26+. However, nothing in the evidence describes a guided, one-step flow that moves all tokens to a new phone. Import/export between apps is an adjacent capability, not the device-migration experience the story asks for.

support.subject: As an everyday user, moving to a new phone transfers all my tokens in one guided step
